# NEW 2026-11-18 AI routines for an AI-run Byzantium. Generated by gen_byz_ai.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# BYZ scope, monthly, AI only. Campaigns: pay the army or negotiate, as a player would with the panel buttons.
oe_byz_ai_campaigns_monthly = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_hc_egypt_active has_variable = oe_hc_egypt_progress has_variable = oe_hc_egypt_pressure }
        if = {
            limit = { var:oe_hc_egypt_progress >= 40 var:oe_hc_egypt_pressure >= 75 }
            oe_hc_egypt_end = { outcome = 2 }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:oe_hc_egypt_pressure >= 60 NOT = { has_variable = oe_hc_pay_cd } gold >= 600 }
            add_gold = -300
            oe_hc_egypt_add_pressure = { amount = -15 }
            set_variable = { name = oe_hc_pay_cd months = 6 }
        }
    }
    if = {

# BYZ scope, yearly, AI only. Themes.
oe_byz_ai_themes_yearly = {
    # Found at most one theme a year in a historical region that can have one (newly taken land), at the player's
    # price of 5 Authority, keeping 10 in reserve. The opening found-all for an AI Byzantium stays as it is.
    if = {
        limit = {
            oe_byz_core_active = yes
            exists = international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars
            oe_theme_any_creatable = yes
            international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = { var:oe_pillars_authority >= 15 }
        }
        ordered_owned_location = {
            limit = { oe_theme_region_center_creatable = yes }
            order_by = population
            max = 1
            save_scope_as = oe_theme_seat
        }
        if = {
            limit = { exists = scope:oe_theme_seat }
            international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = { change_variable = { name = oe_pillars_authority add = -5 } }
            oe_theme_found_at_seat = yes
        }
    }
    # Take back command from the most dangerous ambitious strategos (one a year).
    if = {
        limit = {
            oe_byz_core_active = yes
            exists = international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars
            international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = { var:oe_pillars_authority >= 8 }
            any_subject = { oe_theme_ambitious = yes NOT = { has_variable = oe_theme_disarm_cd } regular_army_size > 0 }
        }
        ordered_subject = {
            limit = { oe_theme_ambitious = yes NOT = { has_variable = oe_theme_disarm_cd } regular_army_size > 0 }
            order_by = regular_army_size
            max = 1
            oe_theme_disarm = yes
        }
    }
    # Officials: a judge from the capital for disloyal themes when rich; dismiss paid officials when in debt.
    if = {
        limit = { gold >= 800 }
        every_subject = {
            limit = { oe_theme_member_trigger = yes var:oe_theme_judge ?= 0 has_variable = oe_theme_loyalty_band var:oe_theme_loyalty_band <= 1 }
            set_variable = { name = oe_theme_judge value = 1 }
            set_variable = oe_theme_tiers_dirty
        }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { gold < 0 }
        every_subject = {
            limit = { oe_theme_member_trigger = yes OR = { var:oe_theme_judge ?= 1 var:oe_theme_fiscal ?= 1 } }
            set_variable = { name = oe_theme_judge value = 0 }
            if = { limit = { var:oe_theme_fiscal ?= 1 } set_variable = { name = oe_theme_fiscal value = 0 } }
            set_variable = oe_theme_tiers_dirty
        }
    }
}
